evidence.summary: Threat model sound for stated scope (single-account credential stuffing). Residual risks recorded: XFF spoofing defeats per-address throttle and can DoS a shared-NAT victim address (see quality.security); single-process/in-memory counters mean a multi-worker or multi-instance deployment without a shared store would divide the effective limit by worker count (not checked against actual deployment config, out of scope for this review); counters clear on process restart; shared-IP collateral lockout is an inherent IP-throttling trade-off, not a defect.

rationale: none of these are AC failures; recorded for the risk register per the brownfield/no-self-authorized-scope-expansion rule.
